task: Predict overall survival in lung adenocarcinoma using discretized time bins. Each class represents one of four survival quartiles combined with censored versus death status. On H&E, relevant prognostic features include predominant growth pattern, tumor grade, necrosis, lymphovascular invasion, pleural invasion, and stromal or immune response.

classes.0: Earliest survival quartile, censored — short follow-up with no death recorded.
classes.1: Second survival quartile, censored — intermediate-short follow-up with no death recorded.
classes.2: Third survival quartile, censored — intermediate-long follow-up with no death recorded.
classes.3: Latest survival quartile, censored — longest follow-up with no death recorded.
classes.4: Earliest survival quartile, event — death occurred early, consistent with aggressive tumor morphology.
classes.5: Second survival quartile, event — death occurred in the intermediate-short time range.
classes.6: Third survival quartile, event — death occurred in the intermediate-long time range.
classes.7: Latest survival quartile, event — death occurred late after prolonged survival.
